Name: Drink Water and Eat Frozen - Kettle and Microwave (CP and AT)
Author: boringvlln
Description:
[right]Have you ever wondered what do the villagers of Stardew Valley even [b]eat[/b] outside of the saloon?
Or have you ever used mods for [b]hunger[/b], making your farmer shove every flower and raw fish they find straight into their mouth?
Do you simply want to add a [b]kettle[/b] to your kitchen?[/right]

[center][/center][right]This mod aims to help with that.[/right]
[size=3][center]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (mandatory)[b]﻿[/b]

and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ (optional, only needed if you want the sprite options for the machines)[/center][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]What does this mod actually do?[/size]
[/list]It adds [b]Frozen Meals[/b] (4 types) for you to cook in a [b]Microwave[/b], sublimated versions of [b]Tea [/b]and [b]Coffee [/b]([i]very nerfed[/i]) to cook in a [b]Kettle[/b] (using Coal), [b]Water [/b]in a cup (make in a [b]Kettle [/b]from 5 Fibers + 1 Coal), two extra Snacks (cheap sweets, store bought), and two complimetary Drinks (made in the kitchen from vanilla ingredients).

[list]
[*][size=3]Can I make [color=#00ff00]normal Tea and Coffee[/color] with this Kettle?[/size]
[/list][size=2][center][b][color=#00ff00]Yes[/color][/b], but there is a caveat.[/center][/size]This mod initially gifts you an [b]Iron Kettle Prototype[/b] - this one only works for "Simulated 4U" tea/coffee. This is an intentional balancing decision. However after you [see spoiler for machine making below], you will get a letter with a crafting recipe for a proper, fully functional [b]Iron Kettle[/b].

Only the second kettle, not the prototype, will be able to craft Green Tea and Coffee (vanilla items). It also uses 1 Coal. Coffee needs 5 Coffee Beans, Green Tea needs 1 Tea Leaf.

[list]
[*][size=3]Where to buy the new items?[/size]
[/list]You can buy most items at [b]Pierre's General Store[/b] and [b]JojaMart[/b]. Some other traders offer only specific items, such as [b]Water[/b]. Gus does not sell this awful food, he has standarts (he might sell you water though, water is fine). Prices vary, so if you want to save up, do not hurry to buy at the first place you go to.

[list]
[*][size=3]How to make machines from this mod?[/size]
[/list][b]Iron Kettle Prototype[/b]: you get 1 for free via a letter on some day of the week. To craft it yourself you need to... 
[spoiler]
reach Mining lvl 4. Requires: 2 Iron Bars, 1 Cookout Kit.
[/spoiler]
[b]Antique Microwave[/b]: you get 1 for free via a letter on some other day of the week. To craft it yourself you need to...
[spoiler]
...reach Mining lvl 9. Requires: 1 Battery Pack, 50 Wood, 1 Radioactive Bar, 1 Quartz, 1 Iron Bar.
[/spoiler]
[b]Iron Kettle[/b]: you receive a recipe for it after...
[spoiler]
 you make 10k in money. The recipe will arrive via letter. Requires: 2 Iron Bars, 1 Cookout Kit, 2 Refined Quartz, 1 Stone.
[/spoiler]

[list]
[*][size=3]What can I make with these machines?[/size]
[/list][b]Iron Kettle Prototype[/b]: Drinkable Water < 5 Fiber, Weak Tea < from Simulated 4U - Tea Package, Weak Coffee < Simulated 4U - Coffee Package. [i]Requires 1 Coal[/i].
[b]Antique Microwave[/b]: Coin Toss - Silver Package, Coin Toss - Gold Package, Coin Toss - Iridium Package, Joja 3-in-1 Burger Package. [i]Requires nothing extra[/i].
[b]Iron Kettle[/b]: Drinkable Water < 5 Fiber, Weak Tea < from Simulated 4U - Tea Package, Weak Coffee < Simulated 4U - Coffee Package, Coffee < 5 Coffee Beans, Green Tea < 1 Tea Leaf. [i]Requires 1 Coal[/i]. 

[list]
[*][size=3]What are the extra drinks?[/size]
[/list]There are two very simple drinks I wanted to add. [b]Coffee with Milk[/b] and [b]Green Tea with Ginger[/b]. Nothing fancy, just simple, homemade drinks to enjoy.
You unlock both recipes automatically as you reach [b]Farming lvl 2[/b].
Because this is slightly outside the scope of this mod, this part is optional (enabled by default). Check the config file if you want to disable these two recipes. Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
BEWARE that if you want these two recipes off, you must disable them in config [u]before your farmer learns them[/u]. Only before. Disabling recipes already learned is not something the game likes, cooking menu is bound to bug out.

[list]
[*][size=3]Can I gift frozen meals to villagers?[/size]
[/list]While you certainly... Can... I would NOT recommend, unless you're trying to get on their nerves. Just like vanilla Joja Cola, these meals are considered to be [i]Trash[/i]. Get [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20723]Gift Rejection[/url] at least, to have it yeeted back at you.

[list]
[*][size=3]Is the food in this mod vegetarian friendly?[/size]
[/list]Food is made from closed packets, and descriptions are kept intentionally vague. [u]Five out of six[/u] food items are vegetarian friendly, meaning you can read it either way. The exception is [u]Joja Burger[/u], which implies possible meat more strongly, albeit not definitively. Here are the descriptions themselves, if you are ok with spoilers:
[spoiler]
"Coin Toss - Silver" -  "Unchewable pasta with an unidentifiable spice taste.";
"Coin Toss - Gold" - "Soggy dough and lifeless cucumber slices make the worst combo.";
"Coin Toss - Iridium" - "Ravioli filling is gooey and wants to dissolve your tongue.";
"Joja 3-in-1 Burger" - "Suspected origin of the filling is even more worrying than the color of the bun.";
"Slightly Stale Doughnut" - "Tastes like overly sweet margarine.";
"Slightly Stale Brownie" - "Aggressively attempts to imitate chocolate."
[/spoiler]

[list]
[*][size=3]Compatibility and recommendations:[/size]
[/list]
You can probably tell that I am still under the spell of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6822]Unsettling Item Descriptions[/url] by Jonqora and friends, because descriptions are intentionally weird.
To stop yourself from spamming the same gifts to villagers, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6944]Gift Decline [/url]by desto.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23617]Survivalistic - Hunger and Thirst (Rebooted)[/url] by Ophaneom and Locked15 - [u]patch is available[/u], optional file on this page.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22006]Food Poisoning[/url] by seferoni is a gem, if you want your farmer to occasionally get sick while eating junk food.
Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7398]Spice of Life[/url] by KarratKake, if you want the energy&health effect from food to diminish, when you keep eating the same food.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking[/url] by blueberry allows food to restore stats gradually, and not instantly. 
For more realistic grocery shopping, with vegetables, fish, juice, and more - see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26086]Realistic Seasonal Shop Inventory - No More Unlimited Stock[/url].

Some of the mods on screenshots:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21090]Clear Glasses[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color - ReShade[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23126]Nyapu's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22938]Portraits[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url], [url=https://discord.com/channels/137344473976799233/933546639669493791/1235910413464637481]The Love of Cooking[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url].


[size=1]Translations are welcome, I used i18n to hopefully make it convenient. Send them to me, so I'll add them here. Alternatively, publish with a dependency.
If you want to make replacement sprites for this mod, you are welcome to do so also. 

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12966]Something pretty[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15952]something spooky[/url]﻿ from my previous mods.
[/size][list]
[/list]
